name: NASA Mars Trek
role: Primary planetary map and layer-discovery portal
supports: terrain, optical imagery, and layer discovery
integration: 保留小型本地 40 km 区域包用于离线路线计算；同时通过 Mars Trek ImageServer/WMTS 链接按当前视区按需读取或导出图层，不下载全球栅格。

name: NASA Mars Trek bookmarked view (-92.87, -16.32)
role: Optional alternate MOLA study area supplied by the team
integration: A bounded MOLA DEM sample around the bookmarked center is stored in data/raw/mars_trek_views/ and is selectable in the Streamlit demo; Jezero remains the primary region.

name: NASA Mars Trek Viking MDIM21 optical mosaic
role: Real optical context for the Jezero local route view
integration: A 512x512 Jezero export is stored in data/raw/mars_trek/ and can be selected as the optical map layer in Streamlit.

name: NASA Mars Trek MOLA ImageServer
role: Real elevation data for the Jezero development sample
integration: A bounded 256x256 GeoTIFF sample is stored in data/raw/jezero_mola_256.tif; scripts/fetch_resources.py can reproduce it.

name: USGS Astrogeology Interactive Mars Maps
role: USGS Jezero geologic context and cartographic reference
integration: 保留小型本地验证栅格；演示页通过 USGS SIM 3464 FeatureServer 按需查询少量 GeoJSON 地质要素。

name: NASA Mars 2020 Perseverance Raw Images
role: Surface-view evidence for science targets and route waypoints
integration: 演示页通过 NASA Raw Images RSS JSON 按需读取最新 Sol、相机、缩略图 URL 和详情页；图片字节留在 NASA CDN。

name: Curiosity Proposed Path up Mount Sharp
role: Reference for combining mission routes with multiple science layers
integration: 演示页保留 NASA 页面和原始 GIF 的远程链接；本地小样本仅作为离线回退，不作为导航路径。
